title: Research: higher-rank paired boundary at a single ADD gate
body:
## Scope

Cycle seed `3444f4b8606069e8d454447c1dc60c12`; track `complex-mechanisms`; task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`; priority revision 3; exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Selected-record SHA256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

This is a finite conditional interface screen for one binary ADD gate with two positive frame climbs where at least one quotient rank exceeds one. It extends the rank-one `J2` proposal in draft PR #1764 by treating the higher-rank pair `(r,s)` as one hypothetical `J_{r,s}` child of rank `r+s`. It does not admit that supplier or claim a new `κ`.

## Exact mechanism and census

On the pinned selected local word (compressed `FULL-WORD.json.gz` SHA256 `49596aa4ed4fd36cd4582fd0e8ddeb09fd80370a7d8aea1ede52a135b536d289`; decompressed SHA256 `c2b294300760e1fd6eeab8c22c4d13e4633dca40e52cac8da0d68163a76e3ca8`), each qualifying gate is the exact shear `T_c(x,y)=(x+c y,y)`, determinant one with inverse `T_-c`. If the old dirty frames are `U,V` and the common target is `F`, then `U×V` has codimension `r+s` in `F×F`; the invertible shear preserves its dimension, so the joint boundary has codimension `r+s`.

The full scan checks A, B and scheduled cleanup-tail operations in both orientations, exact rational coefficients, monotone frame inclusion and old/new endpoints. It finds 359 higher-rank gate pairs:

- `(1,2)`: 72; `(1,3)`: 52; `(1,4)`: 35; `(1,5)`: 26
- `(2,2)`: 14; `(2,3)`: 5; `(2,4)`: 19
- `(3,3)`: 122; `(3,4)`: 6; `(4,4)`: 8

`CENSUS.tsv` records the exact source gate and frame identifiers for each row; `RESULT.json` is reconstructed by the verifier.

## Conditional cost result

The comparison starts from the selected profile `{1:2412,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}`. For a like-for-like conditional extension it reconstructs PR #1764's 753 rank-one pairs (590 same-gate pairs plus 163 terminal pairs), then applies only these 359 higher-rank gate pairings:

- PR #1764 candidate profile: `{1:906,2:1171,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}`
- Extended profile: `{1:721,2:1047,3:197,4:132,5:96,6:167,7:6,8:16}`
- Rank mass remains 5,586; calls per local word fall from 2,741 to 2,382.

Using the selected fixed-word ceiling routine on a `10^-12` grid, the conditional ceiling improves by at least **5.956346700% over the PR #1764 candidate** and 11.510179694% over the selected baseline profile. This assumes zero extra joint-interface cost.

At 1.05 times the upper endpoint of the PR #1764 ceiling, the exact rank-one-equivalent overhead allowance is 43 additional child costs per local call; 44 fail. A hypothetical one-rank-one adapter per each of the 359 boundaries gives a relaxation moment above one and misses the 5% incremental target. The complete source, copy, helper, hosting, restoration, phase and precision ledger is in the README.

## Reproduce and limits

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-joint-higher-rank-seed3444f4/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-joint-higher-rank-seed3444f4/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-joint-higher-rank-seed3444f4 --check-only
make selected-record-check
```

Both direct replays pass under local Python 3.14.7; package source-pin validation and `make selected-record-check` pass. Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run locally. Four mutation controls reject a changed coefficient, rank sum, inverse matrix and old-frame endpoint.

Predecessors are PR #1764 / Discussion #1765 (rank-one joint pairs), PR #1814 / Discussion #1167 (three-source consecutive gather), and PR #1817 / Discussion #1596 (diagonal rank-one batching). This package does not compose their profiles. The proposed `J_{r,s}` supplier, physical adapters and complete-call hosting remain open; no global assembly, selected-result change or new `κ` is claimed.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed in the package. The research claim and final overlap snapshots are recorded there; the claim is [Discussion #1167, comment #18922740](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18922740).
